about: Every checkbox of START-HERE-Claude.md sections 4, 5, 6, 7 and 10 (86 items), and whether it is already true of the shipped forearm atlas (branch claude/vigilant-galileo-u91fr3, head 95f4cdf). TRUE: already true. PARTLY: true in part, the rest said. NOT-YET: not built. PACKAGE-TASK: work on the package or its import, nothing for the shipped atlas to be. CONFLICT: the item conflicts with 02-design.md or a later binding note; the decision is given.

items.item: Resolve all existing catalog IDs through a mapping table; preserve historical IDs.
items.evidence: Catalog ids are literal and never renumbered (client/src/lib/exerciseCatalog.ts:13441-13443; exerciseCatalogForearm.ts:7-10); mappings are keyed by catalog id with no name matching (regions/forearm/mappings.ts:6-7; 02-design.md:36). The fa-* to catalog table did not exist: reconciliation.json is its first draft (19 match, 9 ambiguous, 1 alias, 28 none).

items.item: Treat fa-* IDs as external seed IDs.
items.evidence: No fa-* id appears in shared/, client/src or server/ (searched); nothing has been imported.

items.item: Preserve original candidate numbers.
items.evidence: Kept in reconciliation.json (originalCandidate); the app has no field for them and needs none outside the import report.

items.item: Alias candidate 22 to 12.
items.evidence: Both resolve to one catalog row, 411 One-Arm Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl (variants/forearm.ts:131); no second record exists to dose twice.

items.item: Split candidate 32 into wrist flexion and extension machines.
items.evidence: The catalog has no wrist machine (catalog search: wrist rows are 139, 140, 141, 350, 410, 411, 415, 416). Would be two new catalog rows from 417.

items.item: Split candidate 37 into kettlebell wrist flexion and extension.
items.evidence: No kettlebell wrist curl in the catalog.

items.item: Split candidate 50 into individually logged rice-bucket actions.
items.evidence: No rice-bucket row. The principle (one action per row, a mixed routine is not several credited sets) is already the catalog's: the wrist roller has a row per wind (exerciseCatalogForearm.ts:18-21; 05-mappings.md:67).

items.item: Resolve 7, 10, 13, 27, 39, 40 before scoring; block future ambiguous protocols.
items.evidence: The atlas never guesses: an exercise with no reviewed mapping counts region-level only (rules.ts:35; 02-design.md:64), and deliberately unmapped rows carry a reason (regions/forearm/unmapped.ts:145-170). The six are not resolved; reconciliation.json lists their candidates (fa-07: 238/141/401; fa-10: 140/401/141/415; fa-13: 407; fa-27: 129; fa-39, fa-40: none).

items.item: Correct candidate 17: pronation is toward palm-down.
items.evidence: 405 Lever Pronation turns palm-down; 406 palm-up (variants/forearm.ts:136-137); actions say 'palm down'/'palm up' (03-anatomy-evidence.md:158).

items.item: Require an offset lever for dumbbell rotation.
items.evidence: 405/406 hold 'a handle loaded at one end' (variants/forearm.ts:136-137); the Zottman turn earns no rotator credit (mappings.ts:259-264; 05-mappings.md:36).

items.item: For deviation, confirm the resistance vector.
items.evidence: 407/408: arm straight at the side, weight in front / behind (variants/forearm.ts:132-133), elbowAngleDeg 0.

items.item: Candidate 23: rope variant separately if its action differs.
items.evidence: No cable wrist curl (flexion) in the catalog. The extension, 350, leaves bar or handle unknown (variants/forearm.ts:129).

items.item: Candidate 16: retain phase information; no full rotator credit.
items.evidence: 136 forearmOrientation 'changing', notes the grip change (variants/forearm.ts:111); turn not credited (mappings.ts:259-264).

items.item: Candidate 48: distinguish repeated squeezing from a sustained squeeze.
items.evidence: No ball squeeze; the gripper is split the same way: 402 Gripper Close (reps) and 403 Gripper Hold (seconds, deliberate hold) (variants/forearm.ts:141-142).

items.item: Fingertip support: keep hand/finger context; do not divide body mass among fingers.
items.evidence: No fingertip exercise in the catalog; no load is ever divided among fingers or muscles (mappings.ts:24-26).

items.item: Grip-target holds deliberate; ordinary compounds incidental.
items.evidence: Holds: deliberateHold true, seconds (variants/forearm.ts:88-92); pulls, hinges, shrugs, hangs: incidental grip (mappings.ts:105-111, 313-330); categoryFor (rules.ts:50-62).

items.item: Record machine identity, grip attachment, straps, assistance, laterality, load convention.
items.evidence: Straps per exercise, side per set (07-logger.md:46-62); laterality and sidedBy per variant (variants/forearm.ts:18-22, 47-60); load conventions (05-mappings.md:69). Not recorded: machine identity, grip attachment or diameter (no value in types.ts:278-280 or variants/dimensions.ts:86-95), assistance.

items.item: Complete every ledger checkbox or document a blocker.
items.evidence: None of the 285 ledger checkboxes (57 x 5) is ticked; reconciliation.json covers box 1 (catalog match) for every record and box 2 (19 cells) for the 24 records with a mapped catalog exercise.

items.item: No rep optima from guessed fibre-type percentages.
items.evidence: The atlas holds no rep ranges at all; no fibre-type field in shared/specialization.

items.item: Do not equate anatomical function with training response.
items.evidence: 03-anatomy-evidence.md:26; rules.ts:41 ('No number here predicts growth'); 09-page.md:90 (sources speak to what a muscle does, not how much it grows).

items.item: Keep validated_muscle_specific_rep_optimum null.
items.evidence: No such field exists.

items.item: Weekly targets unset unless user or reviewed program supplies them.
items.evidence: 'There is no default target and no automatic increase' (02-design.md:78); 'Goal unset -> no fake deficit' (client/src/lib/specialization/brief11.test.ts:271).

items.item: No universal 15+ sets target or automatic 19-muscle escalation.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:78; the target editor says a target is intent and numbers above 15 are fine (09-page.md:97). The owner's 20 Oct stack designer must keep this: total volume is the user's number, never escalated.

items.item: User-directed progression, not compulsory weekly increases.
items.evidence: The atlas has no progression; goals change only when the athlete edits them (09-page.md:97).

items.item: Keep planned and completed work separate.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:72-74; separate cache keys (06-calculation.md:74); 'Add exercise preview -> planned summary changes; completed summary does not' (06-calculation.md:131).

items.item: Store actual ROM/technique qualifiers; do not invent ROM from the name.
items.evidence: A descriptive `range` dimension exists (variants/dimensions.ts:94) but no forearm variant sets it and no set records ROM. The catalog's evidenceContext.rangeOfMotion comes from study calibration per exercise (exerciseCatalog.ts:13444-13456), not from the set.

items.item: Store effort independently of targeting scores.
items.evidence: Effort passes through, absent stays null (06-calculation.md:42; rules.ts:39); there is no targeting score.

items.item: Show load/rep improvements only for comparable exercises.
items.evidence: Exercise performance is one exercise at a time by catalog id and says a different grip, implement or range is a different line (09-page.md:99).

items.item: Do not compare machine stacks, gripper ratings, cables and free weights as equal forces.
items.evidence: Same per-exercise charts (09-page.md:99); grippers log 'number on the implement' (05-mappings.md:51-52); load x reps is labelled external volume-load (rules.ts:38).

items.item: Preserve historical values when the default recommendation changes.
items.evidence: Summaries are computed from the stored sets every time (06-calculation.md:74); published versions are immutable (02-design.md:153; rules.ts:4-8).

items.item: Never alter strength percentiles or rankings.
items.evidence: Strength estimates, volume and percentiles skip hold sets (02-design.md:91); ranking lifts read the database snapshot, not catalog tags (05-mappings.md:44).

items.item: Title the section 'Tendon exposure'.
items.evidence: No tendon section exists (no 'tendon' outside the drawing code in client/src/components/specialization: diagramGeometry.ts:193-261 draws tendons only).

items.item: Explain mapped exposure is incomplete and does not measure strain.
items.evidence: The equivalent statement for muscles exists (rules.ts:41; 10-multi-region.md:533-534 method notes).

items.item: Separate medial elbow, lateral elbow, wrist/thumb and digital views.
items.evidence: No tissue unit or regional group in the model (types.ts has none).

items.item: Deduplicate shared-region bouts; no summed muscle-grade heatmaps.
items.evidence: The region total is distinct bouts, not a sum of rows (rules.ts:36; 02-design.md:66); the map paints bins of direct bouts, never a sum (09-page.md:82-83). No tissue regions to dedupe.

items.item: Keep actual symptoms separate from inferred exposure.
items.evidence: No symptom data is stored anywhere.

items.item: Display 'Not enough information' when tracking is incomplete.
items.evidence: Completeness counts and 'time not recorded' (09-page.md:88, 96; 06-calculation.md:62); no baseline logic.

items.item: Let users inspect source workouts behind a workload change.
items.evidence: Every total opens its sets (09-page.md:85-86), including Progress's weekly bars; there is no workload-change line.

items.item: Neutral prompt to review a new or rapidly changed workload.
items.evidence: None.

items.item: Do not label no symptoms/no work as safe.
items.evidence: Nothing on the page says safe; no green safety colour (exposure ramp only, 02-design.md:102).

items.item: Do not encourage pushing through pain to meet a target.
items.evidence: No pain or symptom prompts; targets are intent (09-page.md:97); nothing is suggested only to raise a number (02-design.md:133).

items.item: Allow reduce, replace or defer a planned exercise from this screen.
items.evidence: Add or Swap with Undo (09-page.md:98; PlanChangeSheet.tsx); no remove, reduce or defer from the page.

items.item: No individualized injury-prevention or rehab prescriptions.
items.evidence: rules.ts:41.

items.item: Locate catalog tables, muscle ids, logger events, calculation owners.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:7-19 (layers), 185-196 (owners); regions/forearm/ids.ts:13-33; 07-logger.md:46-62.

items.item: Find existing direct/supporting/isometric/incidental definitions before adding new ones.
items.evidence: rules.ts:23-30 and 50-62 (categoryFor); types.ts:342-343. The crosswalk is in reconciliation.json vocabulary.

items.item: Read the existing atlas and 3D integration briefs.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:198-218 (renderer contract, 3D viewer); this review read them.

items.item: Field-by-field adapter map.
items.evidence: Not in the repository; the vocabulary section of reconciliation.json is the crosswalk it would start from.

items.item: Live or cached historical results?
items.evidence: Live from device logs with a memo LRU keyed by revisions (06-calculation.md:74); no ledger table (02-design.md:148).

items.item: Ownership/RLS and migration conventions.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:157-170; 04-database.md sections 5 and 9.

items.item: Do not duplicate an existing concept under a new table name.
items.evidence: Shared libraries for actions, sources, variants (10-multi-region.md:276-296); grades, tissue units and tendon exposure would be new concepts, the rest maps onto existing ones.

items.item: Import into staging first; no production enablement of draft mappings.
items.evidence: There is no staging database; PGlite is the only rehearsal (02-design.md:170). Decision: the staging is a draft mapping version in TypeScript (MappingVersion.state 'draft', types.ts:380-386) loaded into PGlite, never emitted to production until reviewed. Drafts never count (02-design.md:64), which meets the package's intent.

items.item: Unique constraints for model/protocol/muscle.
items.evidence: variant_mappings unique (version_id, mapping_key) (supabase/migrations/20261016120000_specialization_atlas_schema.sql:309); one mapping per variant and muscle (05-mappings.md:27).

items.item: Grades null or 0-4; index = grade x 25.
items.evidence: The atlas stores no numeric weight: raw categories only, no fractional accounting, no percentage split (02-design.md:68; mappings.ts:24). Decision: do not import grades or indices as data the calculator or page reads; keep them in the import report as the package's editorial hypothesis behind each reviewed relationship.

items.item: Reject unknown muscle ids; no display-name matching.
items.evidence: Real foreign keys (02-design.md:147); no fuzzy matching (02-design.md:36). The package's 19 ids map one to one onto regions/forearm/ids.ts:13-33 (reconciliation.json vocabulary.muscleIdCrosswalk).

items.item: Alias chains cycle-free.
items.evidence: Variants are replaced only through `replaces` with one current per catalog id (variants/index.ts:21-43); parent cycles refused (02-design.md:151). No exercise alias concept: duplicate catalog names (42/186, 134/337) are mapped identically instead (05-mappings.md:272).

items.item: Preserve nulls through every adapter.
items.evidence: Unknown never reads as zero (02-design.md:64); effort null (06-calculation.md:42); elbowAngleDeg null unless defined (types.ts:326-327).

items.item: Provenance and mapping version in derived output.
items.evidence: Summary carries mappingVersion and ruleVersion (shared/specialization/exposure.ts:696-697); Why this counts shows basis, rationale and sources (09-page.md:90).

items.item: Idempotent import reporting inserted/updated/skipped/blocked.
items.evidence: The seed is generated and drift-guarded (02-design.md:166); no per-run count report.

items.item: Publish reviewed mappings only; unresolved records searchable with an honest unavailable state.
items.evidence: A published version may hold draft rows, hidden from users, labelled pending review, never counted (02-design.md:154; 05-mappings.md:277). Decision: keep 02-design's rule; it gives the package's outcome (nothing unreviewed is counted). Unmapped exercises stay in the catalog and count region-level only (rules.ts:35).

items.item: Cross-user isolation with two distinct users.
items.evidence: server/specializationSchema.test.ts: anon, user A, user B, service role (06-calculation.md:140; 02-design.md:168).

items.item: Symptom data out of analytics and share cards.
items.evidence: No symptom data exists.

items.item: Plan rollback to the previous mapping version without losing raw logs.
items.evidence: The database is forward-only: a correction is a new version (10-multi-region.md:422-425); raw logs live on the device and are never rewritten by a version change. Rolling back means the page reading the earlier key again, which only a release can do.

items.item: Recompute historical projections on activation.
items.evidence: No stored projections; every summary is recomputed (06-calculation.md:74; golden test 06-calculation.md:204-212).

items.item: Backfill in resumable batches.
items.evidence: Nothing to backfill: no server-side projection table (02-design.md:148).

items.item: Invalidate caches after edits, deletes, swaps and version changes.
items.evidence: Cache key holds source and plan revisions, rule and mapping versions (06-calculation.md:74); 'recalculates when a set is edited or a workout removed' (06-calculation.md:136).

items.item: Run `python3 -m unittest -v test_model.py` from the package directory.
items.evidence: 16 tests OK on a copy in forearm-v2/pkg. Under `python3 -I -m unittest -v test_model` the import fails (isolated mode drops the working directory from sys.path); `python3 -I -m unittest discover -v -s <pkg> -t <pkg> -p test_model.py` runs all 16, OK.

items.item: Port the behavioural cases to the app's calculator tests.
items.evidence: Already held: drop set (brief11.test.ts:112), bilateral (58), left-only (69), unknown side (77), straps (156, 167), warm-up/skipped (183), swap (204), edit/delete (240), planned vs completed (06-calculation.md:131). Missing: blocked protocol, conflicting duplicate rejected, tissue-region dedupe, missing hold seconds counted per segment, workload change.

items.item: Retain whole-exercise prescriptions for rows, pull-ups, presses, RDLs.
items.evidence: The atlas never writes a prescription; planned bouts read the plan's own (planBouts.ts via prescriptionOf, 06-calculation.md:30, 108).

items.item: All 50 original candidates traceable.
items.evidence: Package test test_all_candidates_and_cells; reconciliation.json keeps every record with its candidate number.

items.item: 57 records, 19 cells each.
items.evidence: Package test passes; the CSV matches exercises.json cell for cell (1,083 rows, 0 mismatches) and the ledger matches too (57 sections, 0 mismatches).

items.item: Alias resolution and blocked protocols.
items.evidence: Package tests test_alias, test_blocked_protocols pass; nothing to resolve in the app (one catalog row, 411).

items.item: UI never renders unknown as a measured zero.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:64; hatching for no reviewed mapping (09-page.md:83); 'time not recorded' (09-page.md:96); no zeros while loading (09-page.md:91, 109).

items.item: Reps, seconds and loads independent.
items.evidence: 06-calculation.md:56; swap never carries seconds into reps (07-logger.md, 'Swap and add').

items.item: Left-only, right-only, bilateral.
items.evidence: brief11.test.ts:58, 69, 77.

items.item: Drop sets, duplicate delivery, edited/deleted logs.
items.evidence: Drop set one bout (brief11.test.ts:112); duplicate id read once, first record kept, no conflict check (shared/specialization/exposure.ts:529-534); edit/delete (brief11.test.ts:240). The package rejects conflicting duplicates (reference_engine.py:61-64).

items.item: Straps/assistance uncertainty.
items.evidence: Straps yes/no/unknown (06-calculation.md:54; brief11.test.ts:156, 167). Assistance is not recorded. The package engine marks a whole grip-assisted bout unresolved (reference_engine.py:91-93); ours withholds only the no-straps grip mappings (02-design.md:60), closer to the package's own text (START-HERE:291).

items.item: Shared tendon-region deduplication.
items.evidence: No tissue regions.

items.item: Warm-up versus working exposure.
items.evidence: Warm-ups are left out of totals and counted in completeness (exposure.ts:627; rules.ts:19), but the logger never writes `warmup` (07-logger.md:55, 197), so no warm-up exposure exists to show in a tendon view.

items.item: Old-history recomputation and cache invalidation.
Baseline-zero, sparse history, incomplete weeks.
items.evidence: No workload-change comparison; the package's workload_change uses the median of the last four prior weeks (reference_engine.py:153) while its text says the preceding complete windows (START-HERE:219).

items.item: Low-confidence scores stay labelled as estimates.
items.evidence: No scores in the app; under the decision at line 269 none are imported as data.

items.item: No ranking/percentile side effects.
items.evidence: 05-mappings.md:44; 02-design.md:91.

items.item: Reduced motion, keyboard/list access, small screens.
items.evidence: 02-design.md:112; 09-page.md:44-67, 102; the muscle list is the list alternative to the drawing (09-page.md:50).

items.item: Symptom-row isolation and share-card exclusions.
items.evidence: No symptom rows.

items.item: Human reviewers resolve the six blocked candidates and numeric assumptions.
items.evidence: The atlas's own review is automated, not a clinician or anatomist (03-anatomy-evidence.md:25; 10-multi-region.md:530-531).

items.item: Final approved/draft/blocked matrix, tests, screenshots, migration/backfill status.
items.evidence: This reconciliation is the matrix's input; nothing is approved.
